description: This file provides the implementation of a wait queue data structure used within the lighttpd server, managing timed events and callback scheduling.

methods.name: void wq_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback invoked when timer event fires, calls the user-defined callback of the wait queue.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_init(liWaitQueue * queue,liEventLoop * loop,const char * waitqueue_name,liWaitQueueCB callback,gdouble delay,gpointer data)
methods.description: Initializes a wait queue with specified parameters and links it to the event loop.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_stop(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Stops the wait queue's timer event.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_set_delay(liWaitQueue * queue,gdouble delay)
methods.description: Sets the delay for the wait queue, updating the timer if active.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_update(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Updates the timer to fire based on the current head element's timestamp and delay.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_push(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem * elem)
methods.description: Adds a new element to the wait queue, updating the timer accordingly.

methods.name: liWaitQueueElem * li_waitqueue_pop(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Removes and returns the first element that is ready based on the timestamp and delay.

methods.name: liWaitQueueElem * li_waitqueue_pop_force(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Removes and returns the first element regardless of its timestamp, forceful pop.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_remove(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem * elem)
methods.description: Removes a specific element from the queue, updating links and stopping timer if empty.

methods.name: guint li_waitqueue_pop_ready(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem ** head)
methods.description: Pops all ready elements that have timestamps within the delay window.

ctags.name: li_waitqueue_init
ctags.signature: (liWaitQueue * queue,liEventLoop * loop,const char * waitqueue_name,liWaitQueueCB callback,gdouble delay,gpointer data)
